methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Grammar Synthesis (The Review Station)
content: Problem: Students learn grammar in isolated weekly chunks (e.g., past tense one week, future the next). When asked to speak naturally, they struggle to switch between tenses.

Solution: Week 50 acts as a "Review Station." Instead of learning a new concept, students must apply multiple grammar structures (Present, Past, Comparatives, Future) within the same context to solve a comprehensive "Science Mystery."
